media.title: Jan Kiepura reception in Paris, with Bronisław and Eleonora Kaper — photograph, November 1933
media.description: Black-and-white photograph from the NAC series 'Jan Kiepura podczas pobytu w Paryżu' (Jan Kiepura during his stay in Paris), November 1933. A crowd of guests in evening dress poses at a reception in a Paris hotel; a woman in a black dress with a small hat stands at the centre, flanked by two men, and a guest at right holds a signed portrait photograph of Kiepura. Bronisław Kaper and his wife Eleonora are among those present. Narodowe Archiwum Cyfrowe (NAC), ref. 3/1/0/11/8270/3; rights expired (public domain).
media.altText: Black-and-white group photograph at a Paris reception for Jan Kiepura, with Bronisław and Eleonora Kaper among the guests.
media.rightsNote: Public domain: NAC records the rights as expired (Wygasły). Photograph, November 1933 (NAC ref. 3/1/0/11/8270/3).
media.publicCaption: Bronisław and Eleonora Kaper among guests at a reception for Jan Kiepura in Paris, November 1933.
media.publicCreditLine: Narodowe Archiwum Cyfrowe, ref. 3/1/0/11/8270/3; public domain.

timelineEvents.title: Cocktail with Jan Kiepura
timelineEvents.label: 17 Feb 1934 · Cocktail with Jan Kiepura
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Kaper and Jurmann attend a Paris reception for Jan Kiepura as composers of Tout pour l’amour.
timelineEvents.longDescription: In February, Kaper attends a cocktail reception for Jan Kiepura at the George V in Paris together with Walter Jurmann. A contemporary press report names them among the invited guests and identifies them as the composers of the music for Tout pour l’amour.
